description: Read-only: report cook times under a network (recursively by default, slowest node first) and warn about nodes that exceed the frame budget. Returns {targetFps, frameBudgetMs, totalCookMs, nodes[], warnings[]} and changes nothing. Use this to just measure; use optimize_performance when you want suggestions and the option to auto-shrink the slow TOPs.

recursive.description: Measure every descendant (true, default) so cook time inside generated containers is counted, not just the root's direct children.

root_path.description: Network root to measure cook times under.

target_fps.description: Frame-rate target used to flag slow nodes.

name: get_td_performance

frameBudgetMs.description: Milliseconds available per frame at the target FPS (1000 / targetFps).

cook_count.description: How many times the node has cooked, when reported by TD.

cook_time_ms.description: That node's last cook time in milliseconds.

path.description: The network root that was measured, echoing the request.

targetFps.description: The frame-rate target used to derive the per-frame budget.

totalCookMs.description: Sum of the measured nodes' last cook times, in milliseconds.

warnings.description: Budget warnings: one line per node whose cook time exceeds the frame budget, plus a final aggregate line when the summed total cook time exceeds the budget. Empty when everything is within budget.

title: Get network performance
